sources.label: Morphe patches for mobile phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and more.
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Block analytics & tracking
Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Disable AI
Turns off Ask The Post AI, its tab, and AI article summaries.
Hide device identifiers
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Hide next article peek
Hides the edge of the next article that shows on the right at the top of an article.
Hide paywall sheet
Prevents the Washington Post paywall bottom sheet from being shown.
Hide prompts and pop-ups
Hides the prompts and pop-ups you choose in the patch options.
Incognito reading
Experimental. Stops the app and the Post from recording which articles you read. Includes Block analytics & tracking.
Route traffic through a proxy
Sends the app's network traffic through a proxy you choose, such as Orbot or a VPN service's SOCKS5 server.
Skip ads
Removes the ads from the app and hides each ad slot.
Skip age check errors
Opens the app without the "Error on Google Services" dialog when Google Play cannot check your age, such as on a phone without the Play Store. An age result from Google Play still applies.
